ADROIT.description: Upon pickup, Enchant up to 3 cards with Adroit.
ADROIT.name: Kifuda

AKABEKO.description: At the start of each combat, gain 8 Vigor.
AKABEKO.name: Akabeko
AKABEKO.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，获得 8 点 Vigor。

ALCHEMICAL_COFFER.description: on pickup, +4 potion slots filled with random potions.
ALCHEMICAL_COFFER.name: Alchemical Coffer
ALCHEMICAL_COFFER.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 4 个装满随机药水的药水栏。

AMETHYST_AUBERGINE.description: combat rewards gain +15 Gold (not on the final-act boss). Run-41 live: every fight reward showed +15 on top of base gold — funded the 255g Act2 Shop#1 100% sink together with treasure gold.
AMETHYST_AUBERGINE.name: Amethyst Aubergine
AMETHYST_AUBERGINE.zh_description: 战斗奖励额外 +15 金币（最终幕 Boss 战除外）。

ANCHOR.name: Anchor
ANCHOR.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 10 格挡。

ARCANE_SCROLL.description: Upon pickup, obtain a random Rare Card to add to your Deck.
ARCANE_SCROLL.name: Arcane Scroll
ARCANE_SCROLL.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 1 张随机稀有卡牌。

ARCHAIC_TOOTH.description: on pickup, transform your starter card into its ancient version.
ARCHAIC_TOOTH.name: Archaic Tooth
ARCHAIC_TOOTH.zh_description: 拾取时，将你的初始牌变为远古版本。

ART_OF_WAR.description: if you played no Attack cards last turn, start of turn 2+ gain 1 Energy.
ART_OF_WAR.name: Art of War
ART_OF_WAR.zh_description: 若上回合未打出任何攻击牌，第 2 回合起回合开始获得 1 点能量。

ASTROLABE.description: on pickup, transform 3 chosen cards, then upgrade them.
ASTROLABE.name: Astrolabe
ASTROLABE.zh_description: 拾取时，变化 3 张选定牌，然后升级它们。

BAG_OF_MARBLES.description: At combat start (turn 1), apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Run-1 spine relic (弹珠袋×DISMANTLE doctrine). LIVE run-46: purchased Act2 (2,0) shop 169g — paired with Red Mask (T1 all-WEAK) as the auto-Vuln/Weak package that turned every combat into a T1 race window; stacks with Bash/Molten Fist/Dominate Vuln package for Dismantle double-hit lines.
BAG_OF_MARBLES.name: Bag of Marbles
BAG_OF_MARBLES.play_notes: run-46 live: Marbles+Red Mask auto-package = run spine; 99% gold sunk at purchase point.
BAG_OF_MARBLES.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合），对所有敌人施加 1 层 Vulnerable。

BAG_OF_PREPARATION.description: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.
BAG_OF_PREPARATION.name: Bag of Preparation
BAG_OF_PREPARATION.zh_description: 第 1 回合，抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌。

BEATING_REMNANT.description: you cannot lose more than 20 HP in a single turn.
BEATING_REMNANT.name: Beating Remnant
BEATING_REMNANT.zh_description: 单回合失去的 HP 不超过 20。

BEAUTIFUL_BRACELET.description: on pickup, choose 3 cards in deck; enchant them with Swift 3.
BEAUTIFUL_BRACELET.name: Beautiful Bracelet
BEAUTIFUL_BRACELET.zh_description: 拾取时，选择牌库中 3 张牌附魔 Swift 3。

BELLOWS.description: at start of turn 1, upgrade all cards in hand.
BELLOWS.name: Bellows
BELLOWS.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，升级手牌中所有卡牌。

BELT_BUCKLE.description: while you have no potions, you have +2 Dexterity (combat).
BELT_BUCKLE.name: Belt Buckle
BELT_BUCKLE.zh_description: 没有药水时，额外 +2 点敏捷（战斗内）。

BIG_HAT.description: at combat start, add 2 random Ethereal cards from your card pool to hand.
BIG_HAT.name: Big Hat
BIG_HAT.zh_description: 战斗开始，从你的卡池中向手牌加入 2 张随机虚无（Ethereal）牌。

BIG_MUSHROOM.description: on pickup, +20 Max HP; turn 1, hand draw −2 cards.
BIG_MUSHROOM.name: Big Mushroom
BIG_MUSHROOM.zh_description: 拾取时，+20 最大 HP；第 1 回合，抽牌阶段额外少抽 2 张牌。

BIIIG_HUG.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup remove 4 cards from deck; on every shuffle add 1 Soot card to draw pile.
BIIIG_HUG.name: Biiig Hug
BIIIG_HUG.zh_description: 拾取时，移除 4 张牌；每次洗抽牌堆时向其中加入 1 张 Soot。

BING_BONG.description: whenever a card is added to your deck, add an additional copy.
BING_BONG.name: Bing Bong
BING_BONG.zh_description: 每次向牌库加入卡牌时，额外加一份拷贝。

BLACK_BLOOD.description: Heal 12 HP after every combat (IRONCLAD starter Burning Blood upgraded form; Burning Blood heals 6). Acquired via TOUCH_OF_OROBAS swap, which replaces Burning Blood.
BLACK_BLOOD.name: Black Blood
BLACK_BLOOD.play_notes: Run-49 live: heal 12 confirmed eight times post-combat (61→73, 65→77, 2→14 class). Doubles the passive HP rail; the systematic answer to the HP-economy death class. Run-39 first pick precedent held.

BLACK_STAR.description: elites drop an additional relic when defeated.
BLACK_STAR.name: Black Star
BLACK_STAR.zh_description: 精英被击败时额外掉落一件遗物。

BLESSED_ANTLER.description: +1 max Energy each turn; at combat start, shuffle 3 Dazed into draw pile.
BLESSED_ANTLER.name: Blessed Antler
BLESSED_ANTLER.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；战斗开始，向抽牌堆洗入 3 张 Dazed。

BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.description: +1 max Energy each turn; on pickup, add 1 Enthralled to deck.
BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.name: Blood-Soaked Rose
BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Enthralled。

BLOOD_VIAL.description: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP. LIVE run-40: procced every combat (HP +2 on combat-start reads); stacks with Burning Blood end-of-combat +6 and Chosen Cheese +1/+1 on the HP economy rail.
BLOOD_VIAL.name: Blood Vial
BLOOD_VIAL.source: md:relics.md:L20; md:relics_zh.md:L20; codex:relics/BLOOD_VIAL; run-40 live fold 2026-09-18
BLOOD_VIAL.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，回复 2 HP。

BONE_FLUTE.name: Bone Flute
BONE_FLUTE.zh_description: Osty 每次攻击时，获得 2 格挡。

BONE_TEA.description: next 1 combat: at start of turn 1, upgrade all cards in hand.
BONE_TEA.name: Bone Tea
BONE_TEA.zh_description: 接下来 1 场战斗：第 1 回合开始，升级手牌中所有卡牌。

BOOKMARK.description: end of turn, a random Retained card in hand has cost −1 until played.
BOOKMARK.name: Bookmark
BOOKMARK.zh_description: 回合结束时，随机一张被保留的手牌费用 −1 直至打出。

BOOK_OF_FIVE_RINGS.description: every 5 cards added to your deck, heal 20 HP. Shop (5,0) Act2 live price 196g run-43 (unaffordable). Anti-thinning relic - pays out only in card-add-heavy routes.
BOOK_OF_FIVE_RINGS.name: Book of Five Rings
BOOK_OF_FIVE_RINGS.zh_description: 每向牌库加入 5 张牌，回复 20 HP。

BOOK_REPAIR_KNIFE.description: when non-Minion enemies die to Doom, heal 3 HP per such creature.
BOOK_REPAIR_KNIFE.name: Book Repair Knife
BOOK_REPAIR_KNIFE.zh_description: 非 Minion 敌人死于 Doom 时，按每个此类生物回复 3 HP。

BOOMING_CONCH.description: at start of elite combats (turn 1), hand draw +2 cards and gain 1 Energy.
BOOMING_CONCH.name: Booming Conch
BOOMING_CONCH.zh_description: 精英战第 1 回合开始，额外抽 2 张牌并获得 1 点能量。

BOUND_PHYLACTERY.description: at combat start, Summon 1 Osty; at start of turns 2+, Summon 1 Osty.
BOUND_PHYLACTERY.name: Bound Phylactery
BOUND_PHYLACTERY.zh_description: 战斗开始，Summon 1 个 Osty；第 2 回合起每回合开始，Summon 1 个 Osty。

BOWLER_HAT.description: Gold gained ×1.25; only obtainable before the Act-3 treasure chest; never sold in shops.
BOWLER_HAT.name: Bowler Hat
BOWLER_HAT.zh_description: 金币获取 ×1.25；仅可在第三幕宝箱前获得；商店中不会出售。

BREAD.description: turn 1 start, lose 2 Energy; turns 2+, +1 max Energy each turn.
BREAD.name: Bread
BREAD.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，失去 2 点能量；第 2 回合起，每回合 +1 最大能量。

BRIGHT_FLAME.description: Card-grant payload of the Tezcatara STORYBOOK boon - added to deck on pickup; card effect not live-verified run-43.
BRIGHT_FLAME.name: Brightest Flame

BRILLIANT_SCARF.description: the 5th card you play from hand each turn costs 0.
BRILLIANT_SCARF.name: Brilliant Scarf
BRILLIANT_SCARF.zh_description: 每回合从手牌打出的第 5 张牌免费。

BRIMSTONE.description: at start of each turn, gain 2 Strength and ALL enemies gain 1 Strength.
BRIMSTONE.name: Brimstone
BRIMSTONE.zh_description: 回合开始，获得 2 点力量，所有敌人获得 1 点力量。

BRONZE_SCALES.name: Bronze Scales
BRONZE_SCALES.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 3 点荆棘。

BURNING_BLOOD.description: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP.
BURNING_BLOOD.name: Burning Blood

BURNING_STICKS.description: first time each combat you exhaust a Skill, add a copy of it to your hand.
BURNING_STICKS.name: Burning Sticks
BURNING_STICKS.zh_description: 每场战斗首次消耗一张技能牌时，将其一份拷贝加入手牌。

BYRDPIP.description: on pickup, gain the Byrd Swoop card; accompanies you in battles.
BYRDPIP.name: Byrdpip
BYRDPIP.zh_description: 拾取时，获得卡牌 Byrd Swoop；战斗中有 Byrdpip 伴随。

CALLING_BELL.description: on pickup, gain 1 unique Curse and 3 relics.
CALLING_BELL.name: Calling Bell
CALLING_BELL.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 1 张独特诅咒和 3 件遗物。

CANDELABRA.description: at start of turn 2, gain 2 Energy.
CANDELABRA.name: Candelabra
CANDELABRA.zh_description: 第 2 回合开始，获得 2 点能量。

CAPTAINS_WHEEL.description: at start of turn 3, gain 18 Block.
CAPTAINS_WHEEL.name: Captain's Wheel
CAPTAINS_WHEEL.zh_description: 第 3 回合开始，获得 18 格挡。

CAULDRON.name: Cauldron
CAULDRON.zh_description: 拾取时，酿造 5 瓶随机药水。

CENTENNIAL_PUZZLE.description: first time each combat you lose HP, draw 3 cards. Any HP-loss tick triggers it — CrimsonMantle turn-start −1 / BloodWall / Bloodletting / Offering class; with Mantle deployed it is effectively "draw 3 at combat start after T1".
CENTENNIAL_PUZZLE.name: Centennial Puzzle
CENTENNIAL_PUZZLE.zh_description: 每场战斗首次失去 HP 时，抽 3 张牌。任意掉血 tick 均触发——猩红披风回合开始 −1 / 放血 / 祭品类；披风部署后等效「T1 后战斗开始抽 3」。

CHANDELIER.description: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain [energy:3].
CHANDELIER.name: Chandelier
CHANDELIER.zh_description: 第 3 回合开始，获得 3 点能量。

CHARONS_ASHES.description: whenever you exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
CHARONS_ASHES.name: Charon's Ashes
CHARONS_ASHES.zh_description: 每次消耗卡牌时，对所有敌人造成 3 点伤害。

CHEMICAL_X.description: the effects of your cost-X cards are increased by 2.
CHEMICAL_X.name: Chemical X
CHEMICAL_X.zh_description: X 费卡牌的效果增强 2 点。

CHOICES_PARADOX.description: at start of turn 1, choose 1 of 5 random cards to add to hand; those cards gain Retain. Semantics: hand-add with Retain for that combat, new 5-option offer every combat T1 — NOT a permanent deck add.
CHOICES_PARADOX.name: Choices Paradox
CHOICES_PARADOX.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，从 5 张随机卡中选 1 张加入手牌；这 5 张牌均获得 Retain。语义：为本战斗手牌添加（带 Retain），每战 T1 新五选一——**非**永久入牌库。

CHOSEN_CHEESE.description: At combat end (victory), +1 Max HP AND +1 current HP. Event relic from Room Full of Cheese Search (−14 unblockable HP). LIVE run-40: max 86→94; LIVE run-46: 16 procs across the winning run (MaxHP 80→97 net with Lee's Waffle +7 and Feed Fatals minus Paper-Cuts tax). Stacks additively with Burning Blood +6/combat and Feed Fatal +3 MaxHP.
CHOSEN_CHEESE.name: Chosen Cheese
CHOSEN_CHEESE.play_notes: run-46 live: 16 victory procs; HP-rail component with Burning Blood + Waffle + Feed Fatals; Paper-Cuts tax (Act3 scrolls) is the only observed leak — full-block turns cost zero MaxHP.
CHOSEN_CHEESE.zh_description: 战斗结束，+1 最大 HP。每场战斗胜利均触发；与狂宴 Fatel 叠加（芝士 +1/杀 + 狂宴 +3/杀）。由满屋奶酪 Search 选项获得（−14 不可格挡 HP，税精确）。LIVE（对局 36）：每场战斗胜利 **+1 Max HP 且 +1 现值 HP**（state 双数值同涨确认）。

CLAWS.description: on pickup, transform up to 6 cards into Maul.
CLAWS.name: Claws
CLAWS.zh_description: 拾取时，将至多 6 张牌变为 Maul。

CLOAK_CLASP.description: end of turn, gain 1 Block per card in hand.
CLOAK_CLASP.name: Cloak Clasp
CLOAK_CLASP.zh_description: 回合结束，按手牌张数每张获得 1 格挡。

CRACKED_CORE.name: Cracked Core
CRACKED_CORE.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合），引导 1 个闪电球。

CROSSBOW.description: at start of each turn, add 1 random Attack to hand; it is free this turn.
CROSSBOW.name: Crossbow
CROSSBOW.zh_description: 每回合开始，向手牌加入 1 张随机攻击牌；本回合免费。

CURSED_PEARL.description: on pickup, add 1 Greed to deck and gain 333 Gold.
CURSED_PEARL.name: Cursed Pearl
CURSED_PEARL.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Greed 并获得 333 金币。

DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.description: whenever a Curse is added to your deck, +6 Max HP.
DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.name: Darkstone Periapt
DARKSTONE_PERIAPT.zh_description: 每次向牌库加入诅咒时，+6 最大 HP。

DATA_DISK.name: Data Disk
DATA_DISK.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 1 点 Focus。

DAUGHTER_OF_THE_WIND.description: whenever you play an Attack card, gain 1 Block.
DAUGHTER_OF_THE_WIND.name: Daughter of the Wind
DAUGHTER_OF_THE_WIND.zh_description: 每次打出攻击牌时，获得 1 格挡。

DELICATE_FROND.description: at combat start, fill all empty potion slots with random potions.
DELICATE_FROND.name: Delicate Frond
DELICATE_FROND.zh_description: 战斗开始，用随机药水填满所有空药水栏。

DEMON_TONGUE.description: first time each combat you lose unblocked HP on your turn, heal HP equal to the amount lost.
DEMON_TONGUE.name: Demon Tongue
DEMON_TONGUE.zh_description: 每场战斗在自己回合首次失去未格挡 HP 时，回复等量 HP。

DIAMOND_DIADEM.description: end of turn, if you played ≤2 cards this turn, take half attack damage until end of enemy turn.
DIAMOND_DIADEM.name: Diamond Diadem
DIAMOND_DIADEM.zh_description: 回合结束时，若本回合打出的牌 ≤2 张，受到的攻击伤害减半，持续至敌方回合结束。

DINGY_RUG.description: card rewards can now contain Colorless cards. Shop (5,0) Act2 live price 208g run-43 (unaffordable). Dilutes class-pool rewards - low priority unless hunting specific Colorless tools.
DINGY_RUG.name: Dingy Rug
DINGY_RUG.zh_description: 卡牌奖励现在可包含无色牌。

DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.description: on pickup, −9 Max HP; add 3 Apparition cards to deck.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.name: Distinguished Cape
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.zh_description: 拾取时，−9 最大 HP；向牌库加入 3 张 Apparition。

DIVINE_DESTINY.description: at start of turn 1, gain 6 Stars.
DIVINE_DESTINY.name: Divine Destiny
DIVINE_DESTINY.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，获得 6 点星星（★）。

DIVINE_RIGHT.description: on entering a combat room, gain 3 Stars.
DIVINE_RIGHT.name: Divine Right
DIVINE_RIGHT.zh_description: 进入战斗房间时，获得 3 点星星（★）。

DOLLYS_MIRROR.description: on pickup, gain a copy of a chosen card in your deck.
DOLLYS_MIRROR.name: Dolly's Mirror
DOLLYS_MIRROR.zh_description: 拾取时，获得牌库中一张选定牌的拷贝。

DRAGON_FRUIT.description: whenever you gain Gold, +1 Max HP.
DRAGON_FRUIT.name: Dragon Fruit
DRAGON_FRUIT.zh_description: 每次获得金币时，+1 最大 HP。

DREAM_CATCHER.description: when Resting at a Rest Site, you may add a card to deck.
DREAM_CATCHER.name: Dream Catcher
DREAM_CATCHER.zh_description: 在休息点休息时，可以向牌库加入一张牌。

DRIFTWOOD.description: each card reward can be rerolled once.
DRIFTWOOD.name: Driftwood
DRIFTWOOD.zh_description: 每份卡牌奖励可重掷一次。

DUSTY_TOME.description: Event-relic (DARV boon room, run-42 Act2 start): grants CORRUPTION+ (upgraded Corruption, cost 2) to deck. Corruption+: Exhaust; your Skills cost 0 and are Exhausted when played.
DUSTY_TOME.name: Dusty Tome
DUSTY_TOME.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 1 张远古卡牌，且为升级版。

ECTOPLASM.description: +1 max Energy each turn; Gold gained is set to 0.
ECTOPLASM.name: Ectoplasm
ECTOPLASM.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；金币获取变为 0。

ELECTRIC_SHRYMP.description: on pickup, choose 1 Skill card to enchant with Imbued.
ELECTRIC_SHRYMP.name: Electric Shrymp
ELECTRIC_SHRYMP.zh_description: 拾取时，选择 1 张技能牌附魔 Imbued。

EMBER_TEA.description: at start of the next 5 combats, gain 2 Strength.
EMBER_TEA.name: Ember Tea
EMBER_TEA.zh_description: 接下来 5 场战斗开始时，获得 2 点力量。

EMOTION_CHIP.description: if you lost HP during the previous turn, at start of your turn trigger the passive of ALL Orbs.
EMOTION_CHIP.name: Emotion Chip
EMOTION_CHIP.zh_description: 若上回合失去过 HP，回合开始时触发所有充能球的被动。

EMPTY_CAGE.description: on pickup, remove 2 cards from deck.
EMPTY_CAGE.name: Empty Cage
EMPTY_CAGE.zh_description: 拾取时，从牌库移除 2 张牌。

ETERNAL_FEATHER.description: on entering a Rest Site, heal 3 HP per 5 cards in your deck. Heal applies BEFORE the rest-site action is chosen (e.g. +15 at 25-card deck, +12 at ~20-24 cards).
ETERNAL_FEATHER.name: Eternal Feather
ETERNAL_FEATHER.zh_description: 进入休息点时，每 5 张牌回复 3 HP。进入休息点即结算，先于休息选项（如 25 张牌库 +15、~20-24 张 +12）。

FAKE_ANCHOR.name: Fake Anchor
FAKE_ANCHOR.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 4 格挡。

FAKE_BLOOD_VIAL.description: at start of turn 1, heal 1 HP.
FAKE_BLOOD_VIAL.name: Fake Blood Vial
FAKE_BLOOD_VIAL.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，回复 1 HP。

FAKE_HAPPY_FLOWER.name: Fake Happy Flower
FAKE_HAPPY_FLOWER.zh_description: 每第 5 回合开始，获得 1 点能量。

FAKE_LEES_WAFFLE.description: on pickup, heal 10% of Max HP (floor). Fake-merchant price ~56g.
FAKE_LEES_WAFFLE.name: Fake Lee's Waffle
FAKE_LEES_WAFFLE.zh_description: 拾取时，回复最大 HP 的 10%（下取整）。伪商人标价约 56 金。

FAKE_MANGO.description: on pickup, +3 Max HP (+3 current and Max). Fake-merchant price ~43g.
FAKE_MANGO.name: Fake Mango
FAKE_MANGO.zh_description: 拾取时，+3 最大 HP（当前与最大各 +3）。伪商人标价约 43 金。

FAKE_ORICHALCUM.description: end of turn, if you have no Block, gain 3 Block.
FAKE_ORICHALCUM.name: Fake Orichalcum
FAKE_ORICHALCUM.zh_description: 回合结束时，若没有格挡，获得 3 格挡。

FAKE_STRIKE_DUMMY.name: Fake Strike Dummy
FAKE_STRIKE_DUMMY.zh_description: 名称含 Strike 标签的攻击牌额外造成 1 点伤害。

FAKE_VENERABLE_TEA_SET.description: on entering a Rest Site, the next combat starts with +1 Energy.
FAKE_VENERABLE_TEA_SET.name: Fake Venerable Tea Set
FAKE_VENERABLE_TEA_SET.zh_description: 进入休息点时，下一场战斗开始额外 +1 能量。

FESTIVE_POPPER.description: at start of turn 1, deal 9 damage to ALL enemies. Pre-chip confirmed across encounters (e.g. Chompers, millipede segments, KaiserCrab claws each −9 at combat start). LIVE run-47: 9-damage T1 AoE confirmed on every combat in the run including the Act1 Boss (Toadpoles through Waterfall Giant) — reliable pre-chip relic.
FESTIVE_POPPER.name: Festive Popper
FESTIVE_POPPER.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，对所有敌人造成 9 点伤害。预削已在多类遭遇确认（啃咬机、千足虫各段、皇蟹双爪开战各 −9）。

FIDDLE.description: hand draw +2 cards each turn; you cannot draw cards during your turn.
FIDDLE.name: Fiddle
FIDDLE.zh_description: 每回合抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌；回合内不能再抽牌。

FISHING_ROD.description: every 3 Monster combats, upgrade 1 random card in deck. Counter counts Monster-room combats only — upgrades fire after regular monster fights 3/6/9; elite-room fights do not advance the counter.
FISHING_ROD.name: Fishing Rod
FISHING_ROD.zh_description: 每 3 场普通敌人战斗，升级牌库中 1 张随机牌。计数只统计 Monster 房间战斗——普通怪战第 3/6/9 场触发升级；精英战不推进计数。

FORGOTTEN_SOUL.description: whenever you exhaust a card, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
FORGOTTEN_SOUL.name: Forgotten Soul
FORGOTTEN_SOUL.zh_description: 每次消耗卡牌时，对随机敌人造成 1 点伤害。

FRAGRANT_MUSHROOM.description: on pickup, lose 15 HP and upgrade 2 random cards in deck.
FRAGRANT_MUSHROOM.name: Fragrant Mushroom
FRAGRANT_MUSHROOM.zh_description: 拾取时，失去 15 HP 并升级牌库中 2 张随机牌。

FRESNEL_LENS.description: cards that grant Block and are added to your deck are enchanted with Nimble 2.
FRESNEL_LENS.name: Fresnel Lens
FRESNEL_LENS.zh_description: 获得格挡的卡牌加入牌库时，为其附魔 Nimble 2。

FROZEN_EGG.description: Power cards added to your deck are created upgraded.
FROZEN_EGG.name: Frozen Egg
FROZEN_EGG.zh_description: 向牌库加入的能力（Power）牌会被升级。

FUNERARY_MASK.description: at combat start, shuffle 3 Soul cards into your draw pile.
FUNERARY_MASK.name: Funerary Mask
FUNERARY_MASK.zh_description: 战斗开始，向抽牌堆洗入 3 张 Soul。

FUR_COAT.description: Act3/Act2 boon-room relic (NONUPEIPE event, option 3): randomly mark 7 combats; enemies in marked combats have only 1 HP. LIVE run-46: picked at Act3 boon over Diamond Diadem (≤2 plays = half damage) and Brilliant Scarf (5th card free) — 7 near-free fights is the highest-expected-value pick for a mid-HP Act3 entry.
FUR_COAT.name: Fur Coat
FUR_COAT.play_notes: Act2/Act3 赐福房遗物（NONUPEIPE 事件选项 3）：随机标记 7 场战斗，被标记战斗中的敌人仅有 1 点生命。run-46 live：Act3 赐福在钻石头冠与艳丽围巾之间选择皮草大衣——对中等血线入 Act3 而言 7 场近乎免战是期望值最高的选择。
FUR_COAT.zh_description: 拾取时，标记 7 场战斗；这些房间的敌人 HP 为 1。

GALACTIC_DUST.name: Galactic Dust
GALACTIC_DUST.zh_description: 每消耗 10 点星星，获得 10 格挡。

GAMBLING_CHIP.description: at combat start, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
GAMBLING_CHIP.name: Gambling Chip
GAMBLING_CHIP.zh_description: 战斗开始，可弃置任意数量卡牌并抽取等量牌。

GAME_PIECE.description: Whenever you play a Power card, draw 1 card.
GAME_PIECE.name: Game Piece
GAME_PIECE.play_notes: Run-49 live: draw event observed after every Inflame/Vicious/Unmovable/FNP play; natural pair with power-class engines.
GAME_PIECE.zh_description: 每次打出能力牌时，抽 1 张牌。

GHOST_SEED.description: Strike and Defend cards gain Ethereal — unplayed copies Exhaust at end of your turn. Live run-42: unplayed Strikes/Defends exhausted at turn end in boss fights (history "exhausted STRIKE_IRONCLAD/DEFEND_IRONCLAD"); passive clog-thinning; synergy with Corruption/FNP exhaust payoffs.
GHOST_SEED.name: Ghost Seed
GHOST_SEED.zh_description: Strike 和 Defend 牌获得 Ethereal。

GIRYA.description: Rest Sites gain a Lift option (max 3 times); at combat start, gain Strength equal to times Lifted.
GIRYA.name: Girya
GIRYA.zh_description: 休息点获得 Lift 选项（最多 3 次）；战斗开始，获得等同 Lift 次数的力量。

GLAM.description: Card enchant: the first time the card is played in each combat, its effect resolves twice (one free replay; energy paid only once). Later plays that combat are normal.
GLAM.name: Glam
GLAM.play_notes: Run-49 live process note: Glam replay (second resolution) fires after the first resolution fully completes, INCLUDING Headbutt retrieval choose. If the next act is submitted immediately after the retrieval choose, the replay window can be skipped (2 observations). After retrieval choose on a Glam Headbutt, take a settle re-read before the next act when the double matters. Replay damage observed live every turn it fired: 9+9, 12+12, 13+13, 15+15, 22+5-class.

GLASS_EYE.description: on pickup, gain 2 Common, 2 Uncommon and 1 Rare cards.
GLASS_EYE.name: Glass Eye
GLASS_EYE.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 2 张普通、2 张罕见、1 张稀有卡牌。

GLITTER.description: All card rewards are enchanted with Glam (first play each combat replays free — see GLAM).
GLITTER.name: Glitter
GLITTER.play_notes: Run-long enchant engine; see GLAM for the enchant effect.
GLITTER.source: perplexity-search 2026-09-19 (gamerblurb Glam explained; spire-codex.com/enchantments/glam; mobalytics enchantments guide) + live Neow screen F9S4BGVMFD
GLITTER.zh_description: 所有卡牌奖励附魔 Glam。

GNARLED_HAMMER.description: on pickup, choose up to 3 Attack cards to enchant with Sharp 3.
GNARLED_HAMMER.name: Gnarled Hammer
GNARLED_HAMMER.zh_description: 拾取时，为至多 3 张攻击牌附魔 Sharp 3。

GOLDEN_COMPASS.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup, regenerate the current act's map (RunManager.GenerateMap for current act index).
GOLDEN_COMPASS.name: Golden Compass
GOLDEN_COMPASS.zh_description: 拾取时，用一条特殊路径替换第二章地图。

GOLD_PLATED_CABLES.description: your rightmost Orb triggers its passive 1 additional time.
GOLD_PLATED_CABLES.name: Gold-Plated Cables
GOLD_PLATED_CABLES.zh_description: 最右侧的充能球额外触发 1 次被动。

GORGET.description: At the start of each combat, gain 4 Plating.
GORGET.name: Gorget
GORGET.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 4 点镀甲（Plating）。

GREMLIN_HORN.description: When an enemy dies, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): Ovicopter egg-clutch deaths refunded +2 energy mid-turn (energy print 6/3) — kill-chains fund cleanup attacks the same turn; each death resolves its own refund immediately.
GREMLIN_HORN.name: Gremlin Horn
GREMLIN_HORN.zh_description: 敌人死亡时，获得 1 点能量并抽 1 张牌。击杀连锁：每次死亡立刻 +1 能量并抽牌，支撑波次战多杀回合。

HAND_DRILL.description: whenever you break an enemy's Block, apply 2 Vulnerable to that enemy.
HAND_DRILL.name: Hand Drill
HAND_DRILL.zh_description: 每次击破敌方格挡时，对该敌人施加 2 层 Vulnerable。

HAPPY_FLOWER.name: Happy Flower
HAPPY_FLOWER.play_notes: Run-49 live: Act2 elite (12,1) drop; counter displayed :0→:1→:2 across combat turns; energy arrives on the counter-reset turn.
HAPPY_FLOWER.zh_description: 每第 3 回合开始，获得 1 点能量。

HEFTY_TABLET.description: on pickup, choose 1 of 3 Rare cards to add to deck, and add 1 Injury.
HEFTY_TABLET.name: Hefty Tablet
HEFTY_TABLET.zh_description: 拾取时，从 3 张稀有牌中选 1 张加入牌库，并加入 1 张 Injury。

HELICAL_DART.description: whenever you play a Shiv-tagged card, gain 1 Dexterity this turn.
HELICAL_DART.name: Helical Dart
HELICAL_DART.zh_description: 每次打出带 Shiv 标签的牌时，本回合获得 1 点敏捷。

HISTORY_COURSE.description: from turn 2 onward, at start of turn auto-play a copy of the last Attack or Skill you played on your previous turn.
HISTORY_COURSE.name: History Course
HISTORY_COURSE.zh_description: 第 2 回合起，回合开始时自动打出你上一回合打出的最后一张攻击或技能牌的拷贝。

HORN_CLEAT.description: At the start of your 2nd turn, gain 14 Block.
HORN_CLEAT.name: Horn Cleat
HORN_CLEAT.zh_description: 第 2 回合开始，获得 14 格挡。

ICE_CREAM.description: Energy is not reset between turns (only reset on turn 1).
ICE_CREAM.name: Ice Cream
ICE_CREAM.zh_description: 能量在回合之间保留（仅第 1 回合重置）。

INFUSED_CORE.description: at start of turn 1, Channel 3 Lightning; Lightning orbs deal +1 damage.
INFUSED_CORE.name: Infused Core
INFUSED_CORE.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，引导 3 个闪电球；闪电球伤害 +1。

INTIMIDATING_HELMET.description: whenever you play a card costing 2+ Energy, gain 4 Block.
INTIMIDATING_HELMET.name: Intimidating Helmet
INTIMIDATING_HELMET.zh_description: 每次打出 2 能量及以上的卡牌时，获得 4 格挡。

IRON_CLUB.description: Every 4 cards you play, draw 1 card.
IRON_CLUB.name: Iron Club
IRON_CLUB.zh_description: 每打出 4 张牌，抽 1 张牌。

IVORY_TILE.description: whenever you play a card costing 3+ Energy, gain 1 Energy.
IVORY_TILE.name: Ivory Tile
IVORY_TILE.zh_description: 每次打出 3 能量及以上的卡牌时，获得 1 点能量。

JEWELED_MASK.description: at combat start, move a random Power from draw pile to hand; free this combat.
JEWELED_MASK.name: Jeweled Mask
JEWELED_MASK.zh_description: 战斗开始，将抽牌堆中一张随机能力牌放入手牌；本场战斗免费。

JEWELRY_BOX.description: on pickup, add 1 Apotheosis to deck.
JEWELRY_BOX.name: Jewelry Box
JEWELRY_BOX.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Apotheosis。

JOSS_PAPER.description: Every 5 cards exhausted, draw 1 card (counter JOSS_PAPER:n; Ethereal end-of-turn exhausts counted at turn end; resets on proc). LIVE run-38: counter advanced on Offering/Ritual/Tremble/MoltenFist exhausts; proc at :5 drew 1 mid-boss-fight; counter reset to :0 after proc. Passive draw engine for exhaust-package decks.
JOSS_PAPER.name: Joss Paper
JOSS_PAPER.zh_description: 每消耗 5 张牌，抽 1 张牌（计数 JOSS_PAPER:n；虚灵回合末消耗在回合结束计入；触发后清零重计）。run-38 实时：Offering/Ritual/Tremble/MoltenFist 消耗推进计数；:5 时 Boss 战中触发抽 1；触发后计数清零。消耗包牌组的被动抽牌引擎。

JUZU_BRACELET.description: Unknown (?) rooms can no longer roll Monster combats — only events/treasures. Live run-40 + run-42: Unknown rooms rolled events/treasures after pickup; Elite-typed rooms unaffected.
JUZU_BRACELET.name: Juzu Bracelet
JUZU_BRACELET.zh_description: 问号房间不再出现普通敌人战斗；仅可在第三幕宝箱前获得。

KALEIDOSCOPE.description: On pickup, gain 2 card rewards drawn from OTHER characters' pools.
KALEIDOSCOPE.name: Kaleidoscope
KALEIDOSCOPE.play_notes: Cross-character rewards dilute IRONCLAD archetype synergy (self-damage→Str engine); variance pick. Live-confirmed Neow option 2026-09-19.
KALEIDOSCOPE.source: perplexity-search 2026-09-19 (gamerblurb Glam explained; spire-codex.com/enchantments/glam; mobalytics enchantments guide) + live Neow screen F9S4BGVMFD
KALEIDOSCOPE.zh_description: 拾取时，获得来自其他角色的 2 份卡牌奖励。

KIFUDA.description: on pickup, choose up to 3 cards to enchant with Adroit 3.
KIFUDA.name: Kifuda
KIFUDA.zh_description: 拾取时，为至多 3 张牌附魔 Adroit 3。

KUNAI.description: every 3 Attack cards played in one turn, gain 1 Dexterity. Run-41 live: Dex from this relic is combat-scoped — the +1 vanished at the next turn boundary in the Exoskeleton fight; block values computed the following turn must not assume it persists. Fires on the same 3-attack turns as Kusarigama.
KUNAI.name: Kunai
KUNAI.zh_description: 单回合每打出 3 张攻击牌，获得 1 点敏捷。

KUSARIGAMA.description: every 3 Attack cards played in one turn, deal 6 damage to a random enemy. Run-41 live: procced on the eel-quartet T1 third-attack line — the 6 landed on a different target than the attack chain, useful softening for pack fights.
KUSARIGAMA.name: Kusarigama
KUSARIGAMA.zh_description: 单回合每打出 3 张攻击牌，对随机敌人造成 6 点伤害。

LANTERN.description: start each combat with +1 Energy (T1 only). Run-41 live: boss T1 opened at 4/3 display capacity — PS+Strike+Strike or Inferno+Brand+Bash+Strike lines all fit; stacks with Pyre and Pael's Flesh.
LANTERN.name: Lantern
LANTERN.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，获得 +1 能量。蜡烛燃着时与南瓜蜡烛叠层（T1 5 能）；蜡烛燃尽后 T1 回归基础 3 + 灯笼 1 = 4 能 —— 灯笼单独无法恢复蜡烛时代的能量。

LARGE_CAPSULE.description: on pickup, gain 2 random relics; add 1 Strike and 1 Defend to deck.
LARGE_CAPSULE.name: Large Capsule
LARGE_CAPSULE.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 2 件随机遗物；向牌库加入 1 张 Strike 和 1 张 Defend。

LASTING_CANDY.description: Every other combat after the first, combat card rewards gain 1 additional Power-class card option (reward screen shows 4 options instead of 3). Only obtainable before the Act-3 treasure chest. LIVE run-45: counter alternates :0/:1 on the relic stack display; two 4-option rewards observed — delivered JUGGERNAUT (elite reward) and a second INFERNO (fight reward). Power-injection economy piece.
LASTING_CANDY.name: Lasting Candy

LAVA_LAMP.description: at combat end, if you took no damage, upgrade all card rewards.
LAVA_LAMP.name: Lava Lamp
LAVA_LAMP.zh_description: 战斗结束时，若战斗中未受伤，升级所有卡牌奖励。

LAVA_ROCK.description: boss combat rewards gain 2 additional relics (once). Act label is soft — +2-relic reward buttons also observed at an Act-2 boss reward screen (same class as WONGOS act-gate).
LAVA_ROCK.name: Lava Rock
LAVA_ROCK.zh_description: Boss 战奖励额外掉落 2 件遗物（一次）。章节标签视为软性——Act2 Boss 奖励屏同样观察到 +2 遗物按钮（同类 WONGOS 门槛偏差）。

LEAD_PAPERWEIGHT.description: on pickup, choose 1 of 2 Colorless cards to add to deck.
LEAD_PAPERWEIGHT.name: Lead Paperweight
LEAD_PAPERWEIGHT.zh_description: 拾取时，从 2 张无色牌中选 1 张加入牌库。

LEAFY_POULTICE.description: on pickup, transform 1 Strike and 1 Defend; lose 12 Max HP.
LEAFY_POULTICE.name: Leafy Poultice
LEAFY_POULTICE.zh_description: 拾取时，变化 1 张 Strike 和 1 张 Defend；失去 12 最大 HP。

LEES_WAFFLE.description: on pickup, +7 Max HP and heal all missing HP.
LEES_WAFFLE.name: Lee's Waffle
LEES_WAFFLE.zh_description: 拾取时，+7 最大 HP 并回满 HP。

LETTER_OPENER.description: every 3 Skill cards played in one turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
LETTER_OPENER.name: Letter Opener
LETTER_OPENER.zh_description: 单回合每打出 3 张技能牌，对所有敌人造成 5 点伤害。

LIZARD_TAIL.description: when your HP would drop to 0, instead heal to 50% of Max HP (once).
LIZARD_TAIL.name: Lizard Tail
LIZARD_TAIL.zh_description: HP 将降至 0 时，改为回复至最大 HP 的 50%（一次）。

LOOMING_FRUIT.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 31.
LOOMING_FRUIT.name: Looming Fruit

LORDS_PARASOL.description: on entering a MerchantRoom, immediately purchase the merchant's entire inventory.
LORDS_PARASOL.name: Lord's Parasol
LORDS_PARASOL.zh_description: 进入商人房间时，立刻购入商人的全部库存。

LOST_COFFER.description: on pickup, gain 1 card reward and 1 random potion.
LOST_COFFER.name: Lost Coffer
LOST_COFFER.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 1 份卡牌奖励和 1 瓶随机药水。

LOST_WISP.description: Whenever you play a Power card, deal 8 damage to ALL enemies. Event relic (LOST_WISP event Claim option: adds Decay curse + this relic). run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): fired on Inferno/Vicious/Barricade plays dozens of times; typeless 8-instance AoE — under HARD_TO_KILL cap-9 it resolves at full 8; Decay curse in a Power-rich deck becomes Inferno-proc fuel (EoT 2 self-damage fires Inferno same turn).
LOST_WISP.name: Lost Wisp
LOST_WISP.zh_description: 每次打出能力牌时，对所有敌人造成 8 点伤害。

LUCKY_FYSH.description: whenever a card is added to your deck, gain 15 Gold. Trigger sources: shop card buys, card-reward picks, SwipePower stolen-card return on ThievingHopper death (silent deck-add also pays +15).
LUCKY_FYSH.name: Lucky Fysh
LUCKY_FYSH.zh_description: 每次向牌库加入卡牌时，获得 15 金币。触发源：商店购卡、卡牌奖励领取、SwipePower 偷牌在偷窃草蜢死亡时归还（静默入库同样 +15）。

LUNAR_PASTRY.name: Lunar Pastry
LUNAR_PASTRY.zh_description: 回合结束，获得 1 点星星（★）。

MANGO.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 14.
MANGO.name: Mango

MASSIVE_SCROLL.description: on pickup, choose 1 of 3 Multiplayer cards to add to deck.
MASSIVE_SCROLL.name: Massive Scroll
MASSIVE_SCROLL.zh_description: 拾取时，从 3 张多人模式卡中选 1 张加入牌库。

MAW_BANK.description: whenever you climb a floor, gain 12 Gold; stops working after you spend Gold at a shop.
MAW_BANK.name: Maw Bank
MAW_BANK.zh_description: 每次上一层楼，获得 12 金币；在商店花费金币后失效。

MEAL_TICKET.description: on entering a MerchantRoom, heal 15 HP; only obtainable before the Act-3 treasure chest. Shop prices live run-43: 187g Act1 (14,2) / not offered Act2 (5,0). HP-economy relic tied to shop spines.
MEAL_TICKET.name: Meal Ticket
MEAL_TICKET.zh_description: 进入商店房间（MerchantRoom）时，回复 15 HP；仅可在第三幕宝箱前获得。

MEAT_CLEAVER.description: Rest Sites gain a Cook option — **Cook = permanently remove 2 cards from your deck AND gain 9 Max HP**. Cook-vs-HEAL tension is real at low HP (HEAL restores current survivability, Cook compounds deck+MaxHP for later).
MEAT_CLEAVER.name: Meat Cleaver
MEAT_CLEAVER.zh_description: 休息点获得 Cook 选项——**Cook = 永久移除牌库 2 张牌并获得 9 最大 HP**。低 HP 时 Cook 与 HEAL 的张力真实存在（HEAL 恢复当前生存力，Cook 为后期复利牌库+MaxHP）。

MEAT_ON_THE_BONE.description: at combat victory, if HP ≤ 50% of Max HP, heal 12 HP.
MEAT_ON_THE_BONE.name: Meat on the Bone
MEAT_ON_THE_BONE.zh_description: 战斗胜利时，若 HP ≤ 最大 HP 的 50%，回复 12 HP。

MERCURY_HOURGLASS.description: at start of your turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
MERCURY_HOURGLASS.name: Mercury Hourglass
MERCURY_HOURGLASS.zh_description: 回合开始，对所有敌人造成 3 点伤害。

METRONOME.description: first time each combat you Channel 7 Orbs total, deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.zh_description: 每场战斗累计首次引导 7 个充能球时，对所有敌人造成 30 点伤害。

MINIATURE_CANNON.name: Miniature Cannon
MINIATURE_CANNON.zh_description: 升级后的攻击牌额外造成 3 点伤害。

MINIATURE_TENT.description: at Rest Sites, you may choose any number of options.
MINIATURE_TENT.name: Miniature Tent
MINIATURE_TENT.zh_description: 休息点可以选择任意数量的选项。

MINI_REGENT.description: first time each turn you spend Stars, gain 1 Strength.
MINI_REGENT.name: Mini Regent
MINI_REGENT.zh_description: 每回合首次消耗星星时，获得 1 点力量。

MOLTEN_EGG.description: Attack cards added to your deck are created upgraded.
MOLTEN_EGG.name: Molten Egg
MOLTEN_EGG.zh_description: 向牌库加入的攻击牌会被升级。

MR_STRUGGLES.description: at start of your turn, deal damage equal to the turn number to ALL enemies.
MR_STRUGGLES.name: Mr. Struggles
MR_STRUGGLES.zh_description: 回合开始，对所有敌人造成等同当前回合数的伤害。

MUMMIFIED_HAND.description: whenever you play a Power, a random card in hand becomes free this turn.
MUMMIFIED_HAND.name: Mummified Hand
MUMMIFIED_HAND.zh_description: 每次打出能力牌时，手牌中一张随机牌本回合免费。

MUSIC_BOX.description: first Attack card played each turn creates an Ethereal copy in hand.
MUSIC_BOX.name: Music Box
MUSIC_BOX.zh_description: 每回合打出的第一张攻击牌在手牌中生成一份虚无拷贝。

MYSTIC_LIGHTER.name: Mystic Lighter
MYSTIC_LIGHTER.zh_description: 附魔的攻击牌额外造成 9 点伤害。

NEOWS_BONES.description: on pickup, gain 2 random Neow relics; add 1 random Curse to deck.
NEOWS_BONES.name: Neow's Bones
NEOWS_BONES.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 2 件随机 Neow 遗物；向牌库加入 1 张随机诅咒。

NEOWS_TALISMAN.description: On pickup, upgrade 1 Strike and 1 Defend.
NEOWS_TALISMAN.name: Neow's Talisman
NEOWS_TALISMAN.play_notes: Certain but low ceiling: Strike 6→9 / Defend 5→8 class value; decays if starters are removed mid-run. Live-confirmed Neow option 2026-09-19.
NEOWS_TALISMAN.source: perplexity-search 2026-09-19 (gamerblurb Glam explained; spire-codex.com/enchantments/glam; mobalytics enchantments guide) + live Neow screen F9S4BGVMFD
NEOWS_TALISMAN.zh_description: 拾取时，升级 1 张 Strike 和 1 张 Defend。

NEOWS_TORMENT.description: Upon pickup, add 1 Neow's Fury to your Deck.
NEOWS_TORMENT.name: Neow's Torment
NEOWS_TORMENT.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Neow's Fury。

NEW_LEAF.name: New Leaf
NEW_LEAF.zh_description: 拾取时，变化 1 张选定牌。

NIMBLE.description: Enchant keyword (Nimble N): applied to Block-granting cards added to deck — Fresnel Lens (Drowning Beacon event) enchants such cards with Nimble 2. Exact mechanical effect NOT decoded live — treat as unknown until observed in combat; do not plan around it.
NIMBLE.name: Fresnel Lens
NIMBLE.play_notes: | run-46 session: Nimble effect undecoded — Drowning Beacon CLIMB (−13 MaxHP for Fresnel Lens) declined at HP 66; archive-unknown = don't pay certain HP tax for uncertain future value (run-20 lesson).

NINJA_SCROLL.description: at combat start (turn 1), add 3 Shiv cards to hand.
NINJA_SCROLL.name: Ninja Scroll
NINJA_SCROLL.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合），向手牌加入 3 张 Shiv。

NUNCHAKU.description: Every 10 Attack cards played, gain 1 Energy (counter displayed as NUNCHAKU:n; resets on proc). LIVE run-38: proc fired at :10 → +1 Energy same turn (energy display 4/3); Anger/Pacts End 0-cost attacks advance the counter for free.
NUNCHAKU.name: Nunchaku
NUNCHAKU.zh_description: 每打出 10 张攻击牌，获得 1 点能量（计数显示 NUNCHAKU:n，触发后清零重计）。run-38 实时：:10 触发 → 同回合 +1 能量（能量显示 4/3）；Anger/Pacts End 0 费攻击免费推进计数。

NUTRITIOUS_OYSTER.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 11.
NUTRITIOUS_OYSTER.name: Nutritious Oyster

NUTRITIOUS_SOUP.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup enchant every Basic Strike-tagged card with Tezcatara's Ember - cost reduced to 0, gains Eternal keyword, +3 damage on powered attacks.
NUTRITIOUS_SOUP.name: Nutritious Soup
NUTRITIOUS_SOUP.zh_description: 拾取时，为牌库中所有带 Strike 标签的基础牌附魔 Tezcatara's Ember（Ember = **0 费 / +3 伤 / Eternal**——附魔期间基础 Strike 每战免费 +3 结算）。

ODDLY_SMOOTH_STONE.description: start each combat with 1 Dexterity (card-block values +1 all fight). Shop (14,2) Act1 live price 191g run-43 - bought as the Act1-tail gold sink with Tremble (243/244=99.6% sunk). Stacks additively with Dex potions in-combat.
ODDLY_SMOOTH_STONE.name: Oddly Smooth Stone
ODDLY_SMOOTH_STONE.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 1 点敏捷。

ORANGE_DOUGH.description: at combat start, add 2 random Colorless cards to hand.
ORANGE_DOUGH.name: Orange Dough
ORANGE_DOUGH.zh_description: 战斗开始，向手牌加入 2 张随机无色牌。

ORICHALCUM.description: end of turn, if you have no Block, gain 6 Block. Passive safety net on attack-heavy hands; with OddlySmoothStone +1 Dex the passive stays 6 (relic block is not card block). Live run-43: repeatedly covered 6 of 15-24 incoming on no-block-card turns.
ORICHALCUM.name: Orichalcum
ORICHALCUM.zh_description: 回合结束时，若没有格挡，获得 6 格挡。

ORNAMENTAL_FAN.description: Every 3 Attack cards played in one turn, gain 4 Block. Counter resets each turn; +4 block resolves on the 3rd attack card. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): Fan trigger live-verified in multiple combats (block print +4 after 3rd attack; Fan: counter visible in compact state).
ORNAMENTAL_FAN.name: Ornamental Fan
ORNAMENTAL_FAN.zh_description: 单回合每打出 3 张攻击牌，获得 4 格挡。

ORRERY.name: Orrery
ORRERY.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 5 份卡牌奖励。

PAELS_BLOOD.description: At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
PAELS_BLOOD.name: Pael's Blood
PAELS_BLOOD.zh_description: 每回合抽牌阶段额外抽 1 张牌。

PAELS_CLAW.description: on pickup, enchant all Defend-tagged cards in deck with Goopy (adds Exhaust).
PAELS_CLAW.name: Pael's Claw
PAELS_CLAW.zh_description: 拾取时，为牌库中所有 Defend 标签牌附魔 Goopy（附带 Exhaust）。

PAELS_EYE.description: first time each combat you end your turn having played 0 cards, exhaust your hand and take an extra turn.
PAELS_EYE.name: Pael's Eye
PAELS_EYE.zh_description: 每场战斗首次未打出任何牌就结束回合时，消耗手牌并获得一个额外回合。

PAELS_FLESH.description: Act2 Pael boon relic: from turn 3 of each combat onward, gain +1 Energy at the start of your turn. Run-41 live: T3+ energy showed 4/4 with Pyre uncast — stacks with Pyre (+1) and Lantern (T1 only) for a 4-5 energy floor from turn 3.
PAELS_FLESH.name: Pael's Flesh
PAELS_FLESH.zh_description: 第 3 回合起，每回合 +1 最大能量。

PAELS_GROWTH.description: on pickup, choose 1 card to enchant with Clone 4; Rest Sites gain a Clone option.
PAELS_GROWTH.name: Pael's Growth
PAELS_GROWTH.zh_description: 拾取时，选择 1 张牌附魔 Clone 4；休息点获得 Clone 选项。

PAELS_HORN.description: Upon pickup, add 2 Relax to your Deck.
PAELS_HORN.name: Pael's Horn
PAELS_HORN.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 2 张 Relax。

PAELS_LEGION.description: Block gained from your cards is doubled; after a card grants you Block, the relic sleeps 2 turns during which Block is not doubled. LIVE cadence (run-36): NOT once-per-combat — double → sleep ~2 turns → double again, repeating all combat. Impervious 30+Dex resolved at 46 and 62 on Legion-awake turns in multiple combats; Defend+ doubled 8→16-class on awake turns. events.md's older "first block-card each combat" line is WRONG — this sleep-cadence entry is authoritative. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): stacks x2 multiplicatively with VAMBRACE on awake turns; with BARRICADE in play the doubled block persists between turns — without Barricade, banked block decays normally (Ovicopter T2: 64-block turn vanished when Barricade not yet drawn).
PAELS_LEGION.name: Pael's Legion
PAELS_LEGION.zh_description: 卡牌获得的格挡翻倍；卡牌为你提供格挡后，该遗物沉睡 2 回合，期间格挡不翻倍。LIVE 节奏（对局 36）：**并非每战斗一次**——翻倍→休眠约 2 回合→再翻倍，整场战斗循环。实测：Impervious 30+敏捷在苏醒回合结算 46 与 62 多次；Defend+ 苏醒回合 8→16 级翻倍。events.md 旧文「每战斗首次挡牌翻倍」为**错误**——本条休眠节奏为准。

PAELS_TEARS.description: end of turn, if you have unspent Energy, start of next turn gain 2 Energy.
PAELS_TEARS.name: Pael's Tears
PAELS_TEARS.zh_description: 回合结束时若有未花费的能量，下回合开始获得 2 点能量。

PAELS_TOOTH.description: on pickup, remove 5 chosen cards; after each combat, add 1 random removed card back, upgraded.
PAELS_TOOTH.name: Pael's Tooth
PAELS_TOOTH.zh_description: 拾取时，移除 5 张选定牌；每场战斗后随机加回 1 张被移除的牌并升级。

PAELS_WING.description: card rewards gain a Sacrifice option; every 2 sacrifices, gain 1 relic.
PAELS_WING.name: Pael's Wing
PAELS_WING.zh_description: 卡牌奖励获得献祭（Sacrifice）选项；每献祭 2 次，获得 1 件遗物。

PANDORAS_BOX.description: on pickup, transform ALL Strike and Defend cards in deck.
PANDORAS_BOX.name: Pandora's Box
PANDORAS_BOX.zh_description: 拾取时，变化牌库中所有 Strike 和 Defend。

PANTOGRAPH.description: At the start of each Boss combat, heal 25 HP.
PANTOGRAPH.name: Pantograph
PANTOGRAPH.zh_description: Boss 战开始时，回复 25 HP。

PAPER_KRANE.description: enemies with Weak deal 40% less damage to you instead of 25%.
PAPER_KRANE.name: Paper Krane
PAPER_KRANE.zh_description: 带 Weak 的敌人对你造成的伤害 −40%（原 −25%）。

PAPER_PHROG.description: enemies with Vulnerable take +75% attack damage instead of +50%. Stacks additively with Cruelty power (+25%) → Vulnerable target takes +100% attack damage (×2.0). WITHOUT Cruelty: Vuln-target hits = (base+Str)×1.75 exactly — Str is inside the multiplier, not added after. PaperPhrog alone = ×1.75; ×2.0 requires the Cruelty add-stack. Shop price ~196 gold.
PAPER_PHROG.name: Paper Phrog
PAPER_PHROG.zh_description: 带 Vulnerable 的敌人受到的攻击伤害 +75%（原 +50%）。与残酷能力（+25%）加法叠加 → 易伤目标受到攻击伤害 +100%（×2.0）。牌库无残酷时：易伤目标命中值=（基础+力量）×1.75 精确——**力量在乘区内而非乘区后加**。纸蛙单独=×1.75；×2.0 需残酷加法叠层。商店标价约 196 金。

PARRYING_SHIELD.description: end of turn, if you have ≥10 Block, deal 6 damage to a random enemy.
PARRYING_SHIELD.name: Parrying Shield
PARRYING_SHIELD.zh_description: 回合结束时，若有至少 10 格挡，对随机敌人造成 6 点伤害。

PEAR.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 10.
PEAR.name: Pear

PENDULUM.name: Pendulum
PENDULUM.zh_description: 每第 3 回合开始，抽 1 张牌。

PEN_NIB.description: every 10th Attack card you play deals double damage.
PEN_NIB.name: Pen Nib
PEN_NIB.zh_description: 每打出的第 10 张攻击牌造成双倍伤害。

PERMAFROST.description: First time each combat you play a Power, gain 7 Block. Effect archived; run-38 deck contained no Power cards (Feel No Pain/Stone Armor-class skipped) — relic inactive all run. Value unlocks when a Power enters the deck.
PERMAFROST.name: Permafrost
PERMAFROST.zh_description: 每场战斗首次打出能力牌时，获得 7 格挡。效果已归档；run-38 牌组无能力牌（Feel No Pain/Stone Armor 类均跳过）——本局遗物全程未激活。牌组进能力牌后价值解锁。

PETRIFIED_TOAD.description: at combat start, procure 1 Potion-Shaped Rock.
PETRIFIED_TOAD.name: Petrified Toad
PETRIFIED_TOAD.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 1 瓶药水形状的石头。

PHIAL_HOLSTER.description: on pickup, +1 potion slot and 2 random potions. LIVE run-47 Neow option (药瓶皮套/PHIAL_HOLSTER): on pickup +1 potion slot + 2 random potions (rolled SKILL_POTION + POWER_POTION); holster capacity confirmed as 4 when a 4th potion (ATTACK_POTION) was added mid-act.
PHIAL_HOLSTER.name: Phial Holster
PHIAL_HOLSTER.zh_description: 拾取时，+1 个药水栏并获得 2 瓶随机药水。

PHILOSOPHERS_STONE.description: +1 max Energy each turn; ALL enemies start combat with 1 Strength.
PHILOSOPHERS_STONE.name: Philosopher's Stone
PHILOSOPHERS_STONE.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；所有敌人战斗开始时 +1 点力量。

PHYLACTERY_UNBOUND.description: at combat start, Summon 5 Osty; at start of each turn, Summon 2 Osty.
PHYLACTERY_UNBOUND.name: Phylactery Unbound
PHYLACTERY_UNBOUND.zh_description: 战斗开始，Summon 5 个 Osty；每回合开始，Summon 2 个 Osty。

PLANISPHERE.description: Whenever you enter a ? room, heal 5 HP.
PLANISPHERE.name: Planisphere
PLANISPHERE.zh_description: 进入问号房间时，回复 5 HP。

POCKETWATCH.description: if you played ≤3 cards last turn, turn 2+ hand draws +3 cards. Run-41 discipline: budget exactly 3 plays on T1 (e.g. Inferno+Brand+Bash) to arm the watch — the 8-card T2 hands delivered Inferno+PS+Pyre lines at two elites and the Act1 boss; a 4th play disarms it for a whole turn.
POCKETWATCH.name: Pocketwatch
POCKETWATCH.zh_description: 若上回合打出的牌 ≤3 张，第 2 回合起抽牌阶段额外抽 3 张牌。

POLLINOUS_CORE.name: Pollinous Core
POLLINOUS_CORE.zh_description: 每第 4 回合，抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌。

POMANDER.name: Pomander
POMANDER.zh_description: 拾取时，升级 1 张选定牌。

POTION_BELT.name: Potion Belt
POTION_BELT.play_notes: Run-49 live: Act2 宝箱 (8,2) 获得；belt 容量扩大后商店购入双药水+精英掉落三药可共存（Blood/Skill/Speed 类实测同时在栏）。
POTION_BELT.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 2 个药水栏。

POWER_CELL.description: at combat start (turn 1), add 2 zero-cost cards from draw pile to hand.
POWER_CELL.name: Power Cell
POWER_CELL.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合），从抽牌堆将 2 张零费牌加入手牌。

PRAYER_WHEEL.description: Monster combat rewards gain 1 additional card reward.
PRAYER_WHEEL.name: Prayer Wheel
PRAYER_WHEEL.zh_description: 普通敌人战斗奖励额外掉落 1 份卡牌奖励。

PRECARIOUS_SHEARS.description: on pickup, remove 2 cards and lose 16 HP.
PRECARIOUS_SHEARS.name: Precarious Shears
PRECARIOUS_SHEARS.zh_description: 拾取时，移除 2 张牌并失去 16 HP。

PRECISE_SCISSORS.description: Upon pickup, remove 1 card from your Deck.
PRECISE_SCISSORS.name: Precise Scissors
PRECISE_SCISSORS.zh_description: 拾取时，从牌库移除 1 张牌。

PRESERVED_FOG.description: on pickup, remove 3 cards; add 1 Folly to deck.
PRESERVED_FOG.name: Preserved Fog
PRESERVED_FOG.zh_description: 拾取时，移除 3 张牌；向牌库加入 1 张 Folly。

PRISMATIC_GEM.description: +1 max Energy each turn; card rewards include cards from other characters.
PRISMATIC_GEM.name: Prismatic Gem
PRISMATIC_GEM.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；卡牌奖励包含其他角色的牌。

PUMPKIN_CANDLE.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): +1 Max Energy while KindleCount>0; -1 per combat end; rest sites add a Kindle option that restores +5. Counter visible.
PUMPKIN_CANDLE.name: Pumpkin Candle
PUMPKIN_CANDLE.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；5 场战斗后熄灭；休息点获得 Kindle 选项（+5 场战斗）。第 5 战准时燃尽；KINDLE 作为营火第三按钮（HEAL/SMITH/KINDLE）出现；复燃消耗当次营火行动 —— HP 危机迫使每次营火都 HEAL 时蜡烛在 Boss 战前保持熄灭。

PUNCH_DAGGER.description: on pickup, choose 1 Attack card to enchant with Momentum 5.
PUNCH_DAGGER.name: Punch Dagger
PUNCH_DAGGER.zh_description: 拾取时，选择 1 张攻击牌附魔 Momentum 5。

RADIANT.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 Luminesce into your Hand.
RADIANT.name: Radiant Pearl

RADIANT_PEARL.description: at start of turn 1, add 1 Luminesce to hand.
RADIANT_PEARL.name: Radiant Pearl
RADIANT_PEARL.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，向手牌加入 1 张 Luminesce。

RAGE.description: Lookup-collision carrier (run-46 session): relic-domain key RAGE auto-folded cross-search — actual content is Sling of Courage (Shop relic: start each Elite combat with +2 Strength). Ironclad RAGE is a CARD, not a relic. Sling of Courage shop-priced 74-78g class seen run-46 Act2 shop.
RAGE.name: Sling of Courage
RAGE.play_notes: | run-46 session: key-collision carrier for Sling of Courage; card-domain RAGE is the Ironclad skill-attack card, separate entry.

RAINBOW_RING.description: first time each turn you play an Attack, a Skill and a Power, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
RAINBOW_RING.name: Rainbow Ring
RAINBOW_RING.zh_description: 单回合首次打出攻击、技能、能力各一张时，获得 1 点力量和 1 点敏捷。

RAZOR_TOOTH.description: whenever you play an Attack or Skill card, upgrade it for the rest of combat. Semantics refined LIVE run-48: per-CARD-INSTANCE — the triggering play uses BASE values; THAT copy is upgraded for its own subsequent plays in the same combat. Fresh copies drawn later still play base first (run-48 Strikes: Whetstone-upgraded copy hit 9 first, un-upgraded copies hit 6 first then upgraded). NOT a global card-type upgrade. In-combat examples: Shrug 8 first play → 12-class later plays; Breakthrough 9 first → 13 later; Bloodletting+ energy display 6/3 when its copy carried the upgrade.
RAZOR_TOOTH.name: Razor Tooth
RAZOR_TOOTH.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: per-instance semantics confirmed — fresh copies play base first; Whetstone-upgraded copies distinct from Razor-upgraded ones. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]
RAZOR_TOOTH.zh_description: 每次打出攻击或技能牌时，本场战斗内将其升级。语义：触发升级的那次打出仍按**基础值**结算，该牌此后本战打出才用升级值（如 Rage 首打 Amount 3/后打 5、Defend 首打 5/后打 8；速度药水敏捷回合的后打 Defend 读数 13 = 基础5+升级3+敏捷5）。

RED_MASK.description: At combat start (turn 1), apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies. LIVE runs 38+40: Weak visible on every enemy T1; cuts attack intents PER-HIT for multi-hit moves (Exoskeleton Skitter 1x3→0x3; Entomancer bees 3x7→2x7; Bowlbug HEADBUTT 15→11; LagavulinMatriarch untouched T1 since ASLEEP). Weak decrements end of their side turn. Bought run-40 Act2 Shop#1 162g — delivered in every subsequent fight.
RED_MASK.name: Red Mask
RED_MASK.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合）对所有敌人施加 1 层虚弱。run-38 实时：全部战斗 T1 敌方均可见 WEAK_POWER:1（Byrdonis SWOOP 17→12；史莱姆撞击 4→3/3→2；同族神官球 8→6）。虚弱持续期间敌方攻击伤害约 −25%（其阵营回合结束递减）。与 TERRITORIAL 类被动共存——短暂的「无 Weak」读数是 state settle-lag，非遗物失效。

RED_SKULL.description: While HP <= 50% of Max HP, you have +3 Strength. Live proc run-42: powers line showed STR +3 at 38/80-class entries (display merges with other Str sources — treat live powers line as authority). Turns danger-HP zones into race windows; pairs with HP-economy-low entry fights.
RED_SKULL.name: Red Skull
RED_SKULL.zh_description: HP ≤ 最大 HP 的 50% 时，额外 +3 点力量。

REGALITE.description: whenever you create a card, gain 2 Block.
REGALITE.name: Regalite
REGALITE.zh_description: 每次创造卡牌时，获得 2 格挡。

REGAL_PILLOW.description: Rest Site heal amount increased by 15 HP (stacks with base %-heal and StoneHumidifier-class). LIVE run-46: three rests healed +43-class each (23→66, 33→76, 54-class→full-adjacent) — the pre-boss/pre-elite rest geometry paid double under Pillow.
REGAL_PILLOW.name: Regal Pillow
REGAL_PILLOW.play_notes: run-46 live: +43-class heals at (6,6)/(8,4)/(13,4) rests; draft rest-geometry doctrine paid double.
REGAL_PILLOW.zh_description: 休息点回复量增加 15 HP。与石炉加湿器休息叠加（基础百分比治疗 + 枕头 15 + 加湿器每次休息 +5 Max）。

REPTILE_TRINKET.description: whenever you use a potion, gain 3 Strength this turn. +3 Str fires on any potion use (Dex/Blood/Flex/Attack-class) — lands same-turn as an own power (REPTILE_TRINKET_POWER:3) stacking with potion-native effects (e.g. Flex +5 + Trinket +3 = +8 Str burst window).
REPTILE_TRINKET.name: Reptile Trinket
REPTILE_TRINKET.zh_description: 每次使用药水时，本回合获得 3 点力量。任意药水使用均触发（Dex/血/Flex/攻击类）——以独立 power（REPTILE_TRINKET_POWER:3）与药水原生效果同回合叠加（如 Flex +5 + 饰品 +3 = 单回合 +8 力爆发窗）。

RINGING_TRIANGLE.description: you retain your hand on the first turn of combat. Shop (14,2) Act1 live price 202g run-43 (not bought - OddlySmoothStone+Tremble 243g sunk instead; per-turn Dex valued over T1-only consistency). Do NOT confuse with the RINGING counter-class power from run-13 (1 card/turn) - different thing.
RINGING_TRIANGLE.name: Ringing Triangle

RING_OF_THE_DRAKE.name: Ring of the Drake
RING_OF_THE_DRAKE.zh_description: 第 1-3 回合，抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌。

RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.description: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.
RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.name: Ring of the Snake
RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.zh_description: 第 1 回合，抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌。

RIPPLE_BASIN.description: End of turn, if you played NO Attack cards this turn, gain 4 Block. Live run-42: fired on powers-only turns (e.g. Cruelty+Inferno+Corruption turn vs InfestedPrism -> +4 block); stacks with card block; no-attack discipline is a real survival lever at low HP.
RIPPLE_BASIN.name: Ripple Basin
RIPPLE_BASIN.zh_description: 回合结束时，若本回合未打出任何攻击牌，获得 4 格挡。回合末与卡牌格挡加法叠加（如 Spiral 附魔防御 22 + 水盆 4 = 26）；低血时「弃攻击换挡」是真实生存杠杆。

ROYAL_POISON.description: At the start of each combat, lose 4 HP.
ROYAL_POISON.name: Royal Poison
ROYAL_POISON.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，失去 4 HP。

ROYAL_STAMP.description: on pickup, choose 1 Attack or Skill card to enchant with Royally Approved.
ROYAL_STAMP.name: Royal Stamp
ROYAL_STAMP.zh_description: 拾取时，选择牌库中 1 张攻击或技能牌附魔 Royally Approved。

RUINED_HELMET.description: first time each combat you gain Strength, the amount gained is doubled.
RUINED_HELMET.name: Ruined Helmet
RUINED_HELMET.zh_description: 每场战斗首次获得力量时，获得量翻倍。

RUNIC_CAPACITOR.description: at start of turn 1, gain +3 Orb slots.
RUNIC_CAPACITOR.name: Runic Capacitor
RUNIC_CAPACITOR.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，额外 +3 充能球槽。

RUNIC_PYRAMID.description: you no longer discard your hand at end of turn.
RUNIC_PYRAMID.name: Runic Pyramid
RUNIC_PYRAMID.zh_description: 回合结束不再弃置手牌。

SAI.description: at start of each turn, gain 7 Block.
SAI.name: Sai
SAI.zh_description: 每回合开始，获得 7 格挡。

SAND_CASTLE.description: on pickup, upgrade 6 random cards in deck.
SAND_CASTLE.name: Sand Castle
SAND_CASTLE.zh_description: 拾取时，升级牌库中 6 张随机牌。

SCREAMING_FLAGON.description: end of turn, if your hand is empty, deal 20 damage to ALL enemies.
SCREAMING_FLAGON.name: Screaming Flagon
SCREAMING_FLAGON.zh_description: 回合结束时手牌为空，对所有敌人造成 20 点伤害。

SCROLL_BOXES.description: on pickup, choose 1 of 2 card bundles to add to deck.
SCROLL_BOXES.name: Scroll Boxes
SCROLL_BOXES.zh_description: 拾取时，从 2 捆卡牌包中选 1 捆加入牌库。

SEAL_OF_GOLD.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): at start of your turn if gold>=5, gain 1 Energy and lose 5 gold.
SEAL_OF_GOLD.name: Seal of Gold
SEAL_OF_GOLD.zh_description: 回合开始时，若金币 ≥5，花费 5 金币并获得 1 点能量。

SEA_GLASS.description: on pickup, see 15 cards from another character (5 Common, 5 Uncommon, 5 Rare); choose any number to add to deck.
SEA_GLASS.name: Sea Glass
SEA_GLASS.zh_description: 拾取时，查看另一角色的 15 张牌（5 普通、5 罕见、5 稀有）；选择任意数量加入牌库。

SELF_FORMING_CLAY.description: whenever you lose HP in combat, gain 3 Block at start of next turn.
SELF_FORMING_CLAY.name: Self-Forming Clay
SELF_FORMING_CLAY.zh_description: 战斗中每次失去 HP 时，下回合开始获得 3 格挡。

SERE_TALON.description: on pickup, add 2 random Curses and 3 Wish cards to deck.
SERE_TALON.name: Sere Talon
SERE_TALON.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 2 张随机诅咒和 3 张 Wish。

SHARP.description: SHARP is an Enchant keyword, not a single relic effect: Sharp N = +N attack damage on the enchanted card (run-48 live: SELF_HELP_BOOK option READ_THE_BACK enchants an Attack with Sharp 2 — Bludgeon+ base read 42+2=44 live, 44×1.5 Vuln = 51 on Effigy). Relic GNARLED_HAMMER (Shop rarity) enchants up to 3 Attacks with Sharp 3 on pickup. Enchant damage adds to base BEFORE multipliers (Vuln/Cruelty).
SHARP.name: Sharp (Enchant keyword) / Gnarled Hammer carrier relic
SHARP.play_notes: run-48 live fold 2026-09-19: Sharp 2 on Bludgeon = 44 base (42+2) live; SELF_HELP_BOOK READ_THE_BACK is the grant source. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]

SHOVEL.description: Rest Sites gain a DIG option that grants a random relic. Live run-42 bridge note: DIG button appears in rest UI (button DIG / actions rest(index=2)) but server-side rest(index=2) resolved as HEAL (HP 31->55, no relic granted) — bridge/mod rest-action mapping gap; treat DIG as unavailable until bridge wires it. Game-side relic effect text unchanged.
SHOVEL.name: Shovel
SHOVEL.zh_description: 休息点获得 Dig 选项，可获得随机遗物。

SHURIKEN.description: every 3 Attack cards played in one turn, gain 1 Strength.
SHURIKEN.name: Shuriken
SHURIKEN.zh_description: 单回合每打出 3 张攻击牌，获得 1 点力量。

SILKEN_TRESS.description: On pickup, lose all Gold; all cards in the FIRST card reward are enchanted with Glam (first play each combat replays free — see GLAM).
SILKEN_TRESS.name: Silken Tress
SILKEN_TRESS.play_notes: Cost is gold only (no curse card, no Max HP tax). Bounded econ delay: one early-shop item. Payoff is a Glam'd early spine pick — engine cards double-cast every combat all run. Neow curse-pool slot; live-confirmed option text 2026-09-19.
SILKEN_TRESS.source: perplexity-search 2026-09-19 (gamerblurb Glam explained; spire-codex.com/enchantments/glam; mobalytics enchantments guide) + live Neow screen F9S4BGVMFD
SILKEN_TRESS.zh_description: 拾取时，失去全部金币；第一份卡牌奖励中的所有牌附魔 Glam。

SILVER_CRUCIBLE.description: first 3 card rewards you see are upgraded; the first treasure chest you open is empty.
SILVER_CRUCIBLE.name: Silver Crucible
SILVER_CRUCIBLE.zh_description: 看到的前 3 份卡牌奖励为升级版；打开的第一个宝箱为空。

SLING_OF_COURAGE.description: at start of elite combats, gain 2 Strength.
SLING_OF_COURAGE.name: Sling of Courage
SLING_OF_COURAGE.zh_description: 精英战开始时，获得 2 点力量。

SMALL_CAPSULE.description: Upon pickup, obtain a random Relic.
SMALL_CAPSULE.name: Small Capsule
SMALL_CAPSULE.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 1 件随机遗物。

SNECKO_EYE.description: hand draw +2 cards each turn; at combat start, gain Confused.
SNECKO_EYE.name: Snecko Eye
SNECKO_EYE.zh_description: 每回合抽牌阶段额外抽 2 张牌；战斗开始时处于 Confused。

SNECKO_SKULL.description: Poison you apply is increased by 1.
SNECKO_SKULL.name: Snecko Skull

SOZU.description: +1 max Energy each turn; you can no longer procure potions.
SOZU.name: Sozu
SOZU.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；不再能获得药水。

SPARKLING_ROUGE.description: at start of turn 3, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
SPARKLING_ROUGE.name: Sparkling Rouge
SPARKLING_ROUGE.zh_description: 第 3 回合开始，获得 1 点力量和 1 点敏捷。

SPIKED_GAUNTLETS.description: +1 max Energy each turn; Power cards cost +1 Energy.
SPIKED_GAUNTLETS.name: Spiked Gauntlets
SPIKED_GAUNTLETS.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；能力牌费用 +1。

STONE_CALENDAR.description: at end of turn 7, deal 52 damage to ALL enemies (counter ticks per combat, resets next fight). Live run-43 x2: LouseProgenitor killed from 36 HP at end of our T7 (calendar fired before enemy T7 acted); also observed NOT firing on T6 - the trigger is end of turn 7 specifically. Intangible 1-2 caps this 52 to 1 per instance - do not count on it during FADE windows.
STONE_CALENDAR.name: Stone Calendar
STONE_CALENDAR.zh_description: 第 7 回合结束时，对所有敌人造成 52 点伤害。

STONE_CRACKER.description: at combat start, upgrade 2 random cards in your draw pile for the rest of combat. Hit-list examples: Bash→Bash+ (Vuln 2→3), TrueGrit→TrueGrit+ (random exhaust → **choice-exhaust overlay** — the upgraded form IS the choose-your-exhaust card), Spite→Spite+ (2→3 hits on HP-loss turns), Impervious→Impervious+ (Block 30→40), Hemokinesis→Hemokinesis+ (15→20), Whirlwind 5→8 per hit, Defend 5→8, Strike 6→9, Twin Strike 5→7 per hit, Pommel Strike 9→10. Upgrades are in-combat only and the card display does not mark them; read live damage numbers.
STONE_CRACKER.name: Stone Cracker
STONE_CRACKER.zh_description: 战斗开始，将抽牌堆中 2 张随机牌升级（本场战斗内）。命中示例：Bash→Bash+（易伤 2→3）、TrueGrit→TrueGrit+（随机消耗→**选择式消耗叠层**——升级形态即选择式消耗版）、Spite→Spite+（掉血回合 2→3 击）、Impervious→Impervious+（挡 30→40）、Hemokinesis→Hemokinesis+（伤 15→20）、旋风斩 5→8/击、防御 5→8、打击 6→9、双重打击 5→7/击、剑柄打击 9→10。升级仅战斗内有效且卡面不显示 + 标记，以实机伤害数字为准。

STONE_HUMIDIFIER.description: whenever you Rest at a Rest Site, +5 Max HP.
STONE_HUMIDIFIER.name: Stone Humidifier
STONE_HUMIDIFIER.zh_description: 每次在休息点休息时，+5 最大 HP。

STORYBOOK.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup, add 1 Brightest Flame to your deck.
STORYBOOK.name: Storybook
STORYBOOK.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Brightest Flame。

STRAWBERRY.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7.
STRAWBERRY.name: Strawberry

STRIKE_DUMMY.description: Common relic: Strike-tagged attack cards deal +3 damage; bonus applies BEFORE Vulnerable/multiplier stacking (base-feed). LIVE run-46: Strike resolved 19 on Fabricator mother (6 base +4 Str +3 dummy +3 Str? — live exact: base+Str+dummy fed pre-Vuln 1.5×); Strike 13-class on TestSubject under Str4+Vuln. Event Strike-tagged cards unconfirmed for the bonus.
STRIKE_DUMMY.name: Strike Dummy
STRIKE_DUMMY.play_notes: 常见遗物：带 Strike 标签的攻击牌 +3 伤害；加成在易伤/倍率叠乘前进入基础值。run-46 live：组装师母体 Strike 结算 19（基础+力量+假人先入基础再 ×易伤）；实验体战 Str4+易伤下 Strike 13 级。事件类 Strike 标签牌是否享受加成未确认。
STRIKE_DUMMY.zh_description: 名称含 Strike 标签的攻击牌额外造成 3 点伤害。木偶加成在易伤乘区之前（如 Pommel Strike 18 =（9 基础 +3 木偶）×1.5）；Peck（事件 Strike 标签）的 2 伤段未见木偶加成，事件牌标签覆盖范围未确认。

STURDY_CLAMP.description: Rare shop relic: up to 10 Block persists across turns (partial Barricade). LIVE run-46: purchased Act3 (5,5) shop 289g alongside Energy Potion 48 (337/340 sunk) at HP 8/94 post-Possess-crater — persistent 10-block buffer is the structural answer to the HP-economy wall when skill-based block is taxed by Enrage/Vital-Spark class powers.
STURDY_CLAMP.name: Sturdy Clamp
STURDY_CLAMP.play_notes: 稀有商店遗物：至多 10 点格挡跨回合保留（部分壁垒效果）。run-46 live：Act3 (5,5) 商店 289g 购入（与能量药水 48 合计 337/340 沉淀），购买时 HP 8/94——当技能类挡牌被 Enrage/Vital Spark 类 power 征税时，常驻 10 挡缓冲是 HP 经济墙的结构性解。
STURDY_CLAMP.zh_description: 至多 10 点格挡可跨回合保留。

SWORD_OF_JADE.name: Sword of Jade
SWORD_OF_JADE.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 3 点力量。

SWORD_OF_STONE.description: after defeating 5 elites, transforms into Sword of Jade.
SWORD_OF_STONE.name: Sword of Stone
SWORD_OF_STONE.zh_description: 击败 5 个精英后，变身为玉之剑。

SYMBIOTIC_VIRUS.description: at start of turn 1, Channel 1 Dark.
SYMBIOTIC_VIRUS.name: Symbiotic Virus
SYMBIOTIC_VIRUS.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，引导 1 个暗球。

TANXS_WHISTLE.description: on pickup, add 1 Whistle card to deck.
TANXS_WHISTLE.name: Tanx's Whistle
TANXS_WHISTLE.zh_description: 拾取时，向牌库加入 1 张 Whistle。

TEA_OF_DISCOURTESY.description: next 1 combat start, shuffle 2 Dazed into your draw pile.
TEA_OF_DISCOURTESY.name: Tea of Discourtesy
TEA_OF_DISCOURTESY.zh_description: 接下来 1 场战斗开始时，向抽牌堆洗入 2 张 Dazed。

THE_ABACUS.description: whenever you shuffle your draw pile, gain 6 Block.
THE_ABACUS.name: The Abacus
THE_ABACUS.zh_description: 每次洗抽牌堆时，获得 6 格挡。

THE_BOOT.description: your attack damage to enemies of 1-4 unblocked HP is increased to 5.
THE_BOOT.name: The Boot
THE_BOOT.zh_description: 你对敌人造成的 1-4 点未格挡攻击伤害提升为 5 点。

THE_COURIER.description: merchant prices ×0.80; merchant stock never depletes.
THE_COURIER.name: The Courier
THE_COURIER.zh_description: 商人价格 ×0.80；商人库存不再耗尽。

THROWING_AXE.description: the first card you play each combat is played an extra time.
THROWING_AXE.name: Throwing Axe
THROWING_AXE.zh_description: 每场战斗打出的第一张牌额外再打出一次。

TINGSHA.description: for each card discarded during your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
TINGSHA.name: Tingsha
TINGSHA.zh_description: 回合内每弃 1 张牌，对随机敌人造成 3 点伤害。

TINY_MAILBOX.description: on Resting at a Rest Site, procure 2 random potions.
TINY_MAILBOX.name: Tiny Mailbox
TINY_MAILBOX.zh_description: 在休息点休息时，获得 2 瓶随机药水。

TOASTY_MITTENS.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): before hand draw each combat, exhaust 1 card from draw pile (turn 1 skips Innate) and gain 1 Strength.
TOASTY_MITTENS.name: Toasty Mittens
TOASTY_MITTENS.zh_description: 每回合抽牌前，消耗抽牌堆顶牌并获得 1 点力量。每回合 +1 力零例外；消耗顶牌在无痛部署时同步触发 FnP（消耗源计入无痛）。**与 Headbutt 取回反协同**：取回件置于抽牌堆顶后会被 Mittens 下回合开始时消耗。

TOOLBOX.description: at start of turn 1, choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add to hand.
TOOLBOX.name: Toolbox
TOOLBOX.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，从 3 张随机无色牌中选 1 张加入手牌。

TOUCH_OF_OROBAS.description: Orobas Act2 boon option: replaces IRONCLAD starter relic Burning Blood with its Ancient version Black Blood (heal 12/combat instead of 6). Marks the swap; the heal lives on BLACK_BLOOD.
TOUCH_OF_OROBAS.name: Touch of Orobas
TOUCH_OF_OROBAS.play_notes: Run-49 live: picked at Act2 boon; relic list showed BLACK_BLOOD + TOUCH_OF_OROBAS marker; +12/combat verified same run. Run-39 precedent. Also note: act transition full-healed the player to 80 on entering the boon room (run-49: 29→80) — act-start heal independent of the swap.

TOUGH_BANDAGES.description: for each card discarded during your turn, gain 3 Block.
TOUGH_BANDAGES.name: Tough Bandages
TOUGH_BANDAGES.zh_description: 回合内每弃 1 张牌，获得 3 格挡。

TOXIC_EGG.description: Skill cards added to your deck are created upgraded.
TOXIC_EGG.name: Toxic Egg
TOXIC_EGG.zh_description: 向牌库加入的技能牌会被升级。

TOY_BOX.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup gain 4 Wax relics; every 3 combats the left-most Wax relic melts away.
TOY_BOX.name: Toy Box
TOY_BOX.zh_description: 拾取时，获得 4 件蜡质遗物；每 3 场战斗，最左侧蜡质遗物融化消失。

TRI_BOOMERANG.description: on pickup, choose 3 Attack cards to enchant with Instinct 1. Instinct enchant (decomp): powered attack damage ×2 (multiplicative, applied before other multipliers such as Vulnerable).
TRI_BOOMERANG.name: Tri-Boomerang
TRI_BOOMERANG.zh_description: 拾取时，选择 3 张攻击牌附魔 Instinct 1。Instinct 附魔（反编译）：有源攻击伤害 ×2（乘法，先于 Vulnerable 等其他乘区结算）。

TUNGSTEN_ROD.description: whenever you would lose HP, lose 1 less.
TUNGSTEN_ROD.name: Tungsten Rod
TUNGSTEN_ROD.zh_description: 每次将失去 HP 时，少失去 1 点。

TUNING_FORK.description: every 10 Skill cards played, gain 7 Block.
TUNING_FORK.name: Tuning Fork
TUNING_FORK.zh_description: 每打出 10 张技能牌，获得 7 格挡。

TWISTED_FUNNEL.description: at combat start (turn 1), apply 4 Poison to ALL enemies.
TWISTED_FUNNEL.name: Twisted Funnel
TWISTED_FUNNEL.zh_description: 战斗开始（第 1 回合），对所有敌人施加 4 层中毒。

UNCEASING_TOP.description: whenever your hand is empty during your turn, draw 1 card.
UNCEASING_TOP.name: Unceasing Top
UNCEASING_TOP.zh_description: 回合内手牌为空时，抽 1 张牌。

UNDYING_SIGIL.description: enemies whose Doom ≥ their current HP deal 50% damage to you; Doom on those enemies triggers at start of their turn instead of end.
UNDYING_SIGIL.name: Undying Sigil
UNDYING_SIGIL.zh_description: Doom 不低于其当前 HP 的敌人对你造成的伤害 −50%；这些敌人的 Doom 在其回合开始时触发而非回合结束。

UNSETTLING_LAMP.description: first card each combat that applies debuffs to enemies has those debuff amounts doubled. Values: Uppercut+ (2 Weak / 2 Vuln base) doubled to **4 Weak / 4 Vuln** as the combat's first debuff card; first-debuff doubling applies to the *current in-combat value* of the card — a StoneCracker-upgraded Tremble+ (7-class) doubled to 8 Vulnerable observed, above base-3×2=6.
UNSETTLING_LAMP.name: Unsettling Lamp
UNSETTLING_LAMP.zh_description: 每场战斗首次打出对敌施加减益的卡牌时，减益效果翻倍。数值示例：Uppercut+（基础 2 弱/2 易伤）作为首张 debuff 牌翻倍至 **4 弱/4 易伤**；首 debuff 翻倍作用于打出时的*战内当前值*——被 StoneCracker 先行升级的 Tremble+（7 级）翻倍可到 8 易伤，高于基础 3×2=6。

VAJRA.name: Vajra
VAJRA.zh_description: 战斗开始，获得 1 点力量。

VAMBRACE.description: The first time each combat you gain Block from a card, that Block amount is doubled (card-granted block only; relic/Fan block excluded). run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): stacks MULTIPLICATIVELY with PAELS_LEGION — Defend 5 -> 20 (x2 Legion awake x2 Vambrace) and BloodWall 16 -> 64 confirmed live; first card-block of the combat is the doubled one, later cards face value.
VAMBRACE.name: Vambrace
VAMBRACE.zh_description: 每场战斗首次从卡牌获得格挡时，获得量翻倍。每战首张挡牌精确翻倍（嘲讽 7→14、火焰屏障 12→24、Defend 5→10）；仅首次触发（同战后续 Defend 按面值）。

VELVET_CHOKER.description: +1 max Energy each turn; you cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.
VELVET_CHOKER.name: Velvet Choker
VELVET_CHOKER.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；每回合最多打出 6 张牌。

VENERABLE_TEA_SET.description: On entering a Rest Site, the next combat starts with +2 Energy (T1). LIVE run-40: procs once per rest visit; consumed by the next fight (not all fights after the rest). Stacks with Cocoa/Lantern for 10e T1 after rests.
VENERABLE_TEA_SET.name: Venerable Tea Set
VENERABLE_TEA_SET.zh_description: 进入休息点时，下一场战斗开始额外 +2 能量。

VERY_HOT_COCOA.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): +4 Energy on turn 1 of every combat (AfterSideTurnStart, TurnNumber<=1).
VERY_HOT_COCOA.name: Very Hot Cocoa
VERY_HOT_COCOA.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，获得 +4 能量。

VEXING_PUZZLEBOX.description: At start of turn 1, add a random card from your class pool to hand; free this turn. Live run-42 drops: Juggling(0c) / Whirlwind(0c) / Mangle(0c) / Stoke(0c) / Bloodletting(0c) / Anger(0c) / Evil Eye(0c) / Brand(0c) / One-Two Punch(0c) / Armaments(0c) — added cards persist in combat piles that fight; under Vital Spark generated cards CAN arrive Tainted (One-Two Punch taxed +2 on play run-42).
VEXING_PUZZLEBOX.name: Vexing Puzzlebox
VEXING_PUZZLEBOX.zh_description: 第 1 回合开始，向手牌加入一张随机牌；本回合免费。

VITRUVIAN_MINION.description: Minion-tagged cards deal double damage and gain double Block.
VITRUVIAN_MINION.name: Vitruvian Minion
VITRUVIAN_MINION.zh_description: 名称含 Minion 标签的卡牌伤害翻倍、格挡翻倍。

WAR_HAMMER.description: whenever you defeat an elite, upgrade 4 random cards in deck.
WAR_HAMMER.name: War Hammer
WAR_HAMMER.zh_description: 每次击败精英时，升级牌库中 4 张随机牌。

WAR_PAINT.description: On pickup, upgrade 2 random Skill-card COPIES in your deck (not all copies of a type — live run-42: one Defend granted 8 block, another stayed 5; upgraded copies hidden from rest-site smith list).
WAR_PAINT.name: War Paint
WAR_PAINT.zh_description: 拾取时，升级牌库中 2 张随机技能牌。

WHETSTONE.description: on pickup, upgrade 2 random Attack cards in your deck. Shop (5,0) Act2 live price 151g run-43 (not bought - Barricade taken at 150g instead). Random targets - value depends on attack density. LIVE run-47: pickup upgrades observable via damage numbers — Strike base 6 dealt 9 after Whetstone (2 random Attacks upgraded); deck JSON shows base ids only, upgrade state is damage-inference only.
WHETSTONE.name: Whetstone
WHETSTONE.zh_description: 拾取时，升级牌库中 2 张随机攻击牌。升级目标为攻击标签（如 Bash→Bash+ 10 伤/3 易伤；MoltenFist→MoltenFist+ 14 伤）。

WHISPERING_EARRING.description: +1 max Energy each turn; Vakuu plays your first turn for you (up to 13 cards).
WHISPERING_EARRING.name: Whispering Earring
WHISPERING_EARRING.zh_description: 每回合 +1 最大能量；Vakuu 代你打出第一回合（至多 13 张牌）。

WHITE_BEAST_STATUE.description: potions always appear in combat rewards.
WHITE_BEAST_STATUE.name: White Beast Statue
WHITE_BEAST_STATUE.zh_description: 药水总是出现在战斗奖励中。

WHITE_STAR.description: elite combat rewards gain 1 additional Rare card reward.
WHITE_STAR.name: White Star
WHITE_STAR.zh_description: 精英战斗奖励额外掉落 1 份稀有卡牌奖励。

WINGED_BOOTS.description: 3 charges: when choosing the next floor's room, ignore current route connectivity (any point on the next row). Neow Act1 live run-43 pick over Pommelander(+1 card upgrade) and SilverCrucible(3 upgraded rewards / empty first chest). Doctrine: reserve for rest/shop geometry escapes and pre-boss emergency jumps; charges unused all run-43 (draft geometry held) - unused charges are not a loss if the draft was correct.
WINGED_BOOTS.name: Winged Boots
WINGED_BOOTS.zh_description: 选择行进房间时可忽略路径限制 3 次。LIVE（对局 36）：`map_select` 指向**任意**地图坐标均可成功，无视 `available_map_points` 列表——是完全传送，不限于子节点选择。实用例：(14,3)→(12,6) 商店，再 (12,6)→(15,3) Boss 门，跳过精英走廊；3 跳消耗 2 跳。

WING_CHARM.description: in each card reward, 1 random card is enchanted with Swift 1.
WING_CHARM.name: Wing Charm
WING_CHARM.zh_description: 每份卡牌奖励中，1 张随机牌附魔 Swift 1。

WONGOS_MYSTERY_TICKET.description: after 5 combats finished, the next combat's rewards gain 3 relic rewards.
WONGOS_MYSTERY_TICKET.name: Wongo's Mystery Ticket
WONGOS_MYSTERY_TICKET.zh_description: 完成 5 场战斗后，下一场战斗奖励额外获得 3 件遗物。

YUMMY_COOKIE.description: Ancient relic (Tezcatara boon): on pickup, upgrade 4 chosen cards permanently. Live run-43.
YUMMY_COOKIE.name: Yummy Cookie
YUMMY_COOKIE.zh_description: 拾取时，升级 4 张选定牌。升级为永久牌库升级（deck_select 叠层——逐张 choose 后 proceed 确认）；该方式升级的 Rupture+ Amount 2 此后每次 Bloodletting/Breakthrough 自伤 +2 力量。
